title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a commit revert or package rollback that would restore a row bound to the read-only base is refused per item, naming the .custom pair
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9MzJJFGjBCFjRXi73LUWGL9)_
Fixes #29390

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none needed — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` places every customization of an installed base in its paired `.custom`, declaring `overrides`, and says nothing about reverting a commit recorded against the base itself; nothing it says becomes false.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按提交撤销（`POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert`）和整包回滚（`POST /packages/:id/rollback`）时，若要把旧版本恢复进"绑定只读基础包本身"的那一行（五种可覆盖类型），现在逐项拒绝：该项进 `failed[]`，`code: NOT_OVERRIDABLE`，提示与逐项回滚完全同一句（改写进 `.custom` 配对包并声明 `overrides`），不写任何东西；同一提交的其它项照常撤销。
- 为什么改：#28905 已关掉对这一行的保存、发布和逐项回滚，但按提交撤销绕过了它。实测同一行逐项回滚答 403，按提交撤销却答 200 并改写它；整包回滚每次都把 #28905 之前的提交重放一遍。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄恢复路径，不动存量行；撤销"新建该行"的提交（即删除这行）保持开放，删除命名基础包也照旧开放。回滚即撤销本 PR。另知：配对包提交若与旧基础行并存，因提交计划按任意包读行（席位另立卡），其撤销现在会被拒而不是静默"成功"。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 中 `revertCommit` 恢复分支新增的判定（`restoreVersion` 之前）、`protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe、`package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts` 头注释与最后一个用例。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/metadata-protocol && npx vitest run src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`，应见 22 个用例全部通过（其中 5 个为本卡新增）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` — `revertCommit`'s restore limb (and `rollbackToPackageCommit`, which reverts through it) now asks the #28905 close before `repo.restoreVersion`: `namedBaseOverlayWriteRefusal`, on the binding the restore writes (`resolveOverlayPackageBinding`'s answer, the key `rollbackMetaItem` already uses), with the `rollback` arm of the same sentence (`closedOverlayWriteClauses`, no second spelling).

- **Closed, per item:** a commit item whose restore would land in a row bound to the read-only base itself, on one of the five overlay types that base ships, where the pair fix can be taken (`namedBaseCloseSubject`, unchanged). The item lands in `failed[]` with `code: NOT_OVERRIDABLE` and the sentence; nothing is written; the revert answers `200` with `success: false`; the commit's other items still revert and the revert commit is still recorded. `rollbackToPackageCommit` reports each refused item (`Item 'TYPE/NAME' was not reverted: …`) and continues.
- **Kept open:** the soft-remove limb (the revert of an item the commit created removes the row bound to the base, which writes nothing, as a delete naming the base does); every restore into a row of the pair, a writable package or no package; every restore the pair could not take.
- Seat ruling (record 6579511992): option A, key A1, per-item channel.
- Where the lines live: all of them stay in `protocol.ts`, in `revertCommit`'s class body (the #25467 E2 section 1 split moved `readItemFromMetadataService` through `getUiView`, not `revertCommit`). They cannot move into `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` without a second spelling: the restore limb's only calls before `repo.restoreVersion` are `resolveOverlayPackageBinding` (also read by the cluster write-through replay and by `rollbackMetaItem`, which asks the package-less close first) and `SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion` (the repository layer, no registry, shared with `rollbackMetaItem`).

The sentence an item carries, for `view/showcase_task.default` on the showcase:

> 'view/showcase_task.default' ships in 'com.example.showcase', and a rollback of its row bound to the read-only base is closed (ADR-0146 D1, D11): save the version's body into 'com.example.showcase.custom' (?package=com.example.showcase.custom), declaring overrides: { package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn }. The row is served until the pair declares the override, or a delete naming the base removes it.

## Measured before the change (origin/main 7f277a86, booted showcase, REST)

Commits recorded before the close were produced through the real save and `publish-drafts` doors with the close shadowed on the running protocol instance only, then the close restored (a save naming the base answered 403 again).

| Door, on the row bound to `com.example.showcase` | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| per-item rollback `POST /meta/view/X/rollback` | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` | unchanged |
| revert of the commit that edited the row | 200 `success: true`, `restored`; row rewritten (L3 to L2), served at both addresses | 200 `success: false`, `failed[0].code` `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`; row and served document unchanged |
| package rollback to the first commit | 200 `success: true`; every pre-close apply commit replayed (one reverted twice) | 200 `success: false`, each refused item in `failed[]`; row unchanged |
| revert of the commit that created the row | 200 `removed`; base document served | unchanged (open) |

Full readings, including which commits can carry such a row: only an `apply` commit the base recorded before the close whose item edited an existing row (creation items take the soft-remove limb; `revert` commits record `prevVersion: null`; post-close publishes into the base are refused by `promoteDraftForPublish` where the fix can be taken).

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`, new describe "the commit doors: restoring a row bound to the base is closed, removing one stays open (#29390)" (5 cases, the file's engine double reused, so the engine-double ledger is untouched). Pre-close commits come from `saveMetaItem` + `publishPackageDrafts` with the close shadowed on the instance only:
  - the revert of the base's commit that edited its row is refused per item naming the pair, nothing written (red first);
  - a package rollback through those commits reports each refused item and continues, the row unchanged (red first);
  - CONTROL: the revert of the base's commit that created its row removes it, the base served again;
  - CONTROL: a writable package's commit of the same item reverts its row in place;
  - CONTROL: the pair's own commit (no row bound to the base) reverts its row in place.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`, new last case: on the booted showcase through REST, the showcase's commits recorded before the close: the edited item's revert and the package rollback are refused naming the pair, the served document unchanged; the created item's revert still removes the row and the shipped document is served again.
- **Forced edit (prose only):** the same dogfood file's header said a commit recorded before the close "keeps its revert, as the commit doors still take no read-only guard". That is now true only for the soft-remove limb, so the header says so and names the new case (seat ruling, item 1). No assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, filed by the seat as its own card (serial after this one): a pair commit's revert beside a row bound to the base stored before the close is a silent no-op today, because `publishPackageDrafts`' revert plan and the restore limb both read any package's active row. With this change (key A1) that revert is refused naming the pair instead of answering success over nothing. The plan's `prevVersion` is not changed here (seat ruling).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` (the REST revert door's comment, outside this card's file surface) says undoing a read-only package's overlay commit "stays open": still true of the door (no package-level guard) and of the soft-remove limb; an item-level refusal now applies to the restore limb. Left for the seat to word if wanted.
- The restore limb does not ask the #28576 package-less close; a package-less row is reached there only through the any-package lookup above (same family as the seat's new card).
